provenance.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: ONE full-body native right-facing profile drawing of Karo for a reusable prehistoric story actor; not a redesigned person or an animation sheet.
Input images: Image1 is the PRIMARY authoritative Karo face, warm colors, beard, hair, garment, two-legged shorts, black hands/feet and proportions. Image2 is SUPPLEMENTAL for simple hand-drawn view logic only; do not borrow its white face, simplified triangular tunic or other people.
Primary request: draw the SAME Karo as a genuine side-on profile facing SCREEN RIGHT. Head, nose, chest, hips and feet all point right. One visible near-side black oval eye, short natural nose in profile, friendly modest open smile with source-style white teeth nested inside the beard. Face must sit naturally within the hair/beard without long muzzle, protruding chin, separate floating mouth, stretched forehead or distorted eyes.
Invariants: messy short dark chocolate hair with the original jagged tufts; dense dark-brown beard framing his warm orange-peach face; same brown one-shoulder hide tunic with the same anatomical bare shoulder as Image1; narrow brown cord belt; separate ragged brown SHORTS WITH TWO distinct cuff openings, never a single skirt; slim strong BLACK ink arms and legs; black thumbed mitten hands and large rounded black feet. Preserve full source head-to-body/hair/beard/torso/leg proportions, warm painted highlights/shadows and rich brown cloth with lively irregular black outlines.
Pose: neutral relaxed standing at rest, two arms hanging naturally with soft curvature and correct shoulders/elbows, no tightly folded backward elbow, no action/weapon. Slightly stagger near/far limbs so exactly two arms, two hands, two legs, both cuffs and both feet remain readable while retaining true profile depth. Both flat soles on ONE horizontal baseline; no crouch, walk, jump or extra limbs.
Composition: one complete isolated person from every hair tip to both soles, centered on a genuine transparent RGBA background, generous transparent margin all around. No text, grid, panel, ground shadow, beige rectangle, scenery or checkerboard pixels.
Rendering/color: exact storybook ink/paint feel of Image1, warm saturated skin, dark chocolate hair/beard, earthy medium brown tunic/shorts, full dark garment outline and pure black limbs; opaque-looking interior artwork with clean alpha edges, no background glow or haze. No muscular/flesh-colored limbs, fur shoulder collar, leather boots, straps, jewellery, extra fingers or props.
Only change viewpoint into a newly drawn right profile. Do not mirror or shear/warp the original drawing.

reviewNotes: Giữ mẫu Karo có râu, áo một vai và quần hai ống; nose/beard/neck/tỷ lệ/cuff/foot/alpha cần đối chiếu, chưa identity/pose/contact approval.
Góc yêu cầu là profile phải; actual yaw/landmarks/rig/speech/blink/emotion/occlusion chưa đăng ký.
